Allows QuickCraft clients to request schematic entity placement. The server validates reach, entity data, and materials before consuming materials and spawning the entity.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameLength.name: Fake Player Name Length
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameLength.desc: Sets the maximum fake-player name length from 1 to 128. Long names use a client-compatible network alias.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRangeControl.name: Fake Player Range Control
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRangeControl.desc: Enables area placement, block interaction, area breaking, continuous tasks, and basic pathfinding for fake players.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerProfilePreload.des: Moves fake-player profile lookup off the server thread before spawning. Available on Minecraft 1.21 and newer.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerProfilePreload.ext: false: Keep Carpet's original synchronous profile lookup.
always: Preload every fake-player profile asynchronously before spawning.
adaptive: The first spawn remains synchronous. A second spawn within 30 seconds enables preloading for 2 minutes; each later spawn extends the window to 2 minutes.
carpet.rule.fgaUnicodeArgumentsSupport.d: Allows unquoted command arguments to contain non-English and other Unicode characters. This independent FGA rule does not conflict with YACA's rule.
carpet.rule.recipeBookAlwaysUnlocked.des: Makes all registered recipes available without storing per-player recipe unlock data. Existing recipes remain visible and usable in the recipe book.
carpet.rule.inventoryAdvancementOptimiza: Uses exact item candidate indexing for inventory_changed advancements. false keeps vanilla behavior; exact preserves vanilla matching and falls back safely on inconsistencies.
carpet.rule.playerHealthDisplay.name: Player Health Display
carpet.rule.playerHealthDisplay.desc: Shows health at the right side of player-list names. true shows all players, false shows only for /log playerHealth subscribers, and nofake hides fake-player health.
carpet.rule.itemFrameBlockification.name: Item Frame Blockification
carpet.rule.itemFrameBlockification.desc: Removes item frames from server entity tick scheduling and validates support changes while preserving vanilla rendering, interaction, drops, maps, and comparator output
carpet.rule.fireworkMinecartBoost.name: Firework Minecart Boost
carpet.rule.fireworkMinecartBoost.desc: Lets players riding normal minecarts use firework rockets for configurable full-speed boosts followed by linear deceleration
carpet.rule.chainMinecartBinding.name: Chain Minecart Binding
carpet.rule.chainMinecartBinding.desc: Lets chains connect normal minecarts into persistent linear trains
carpet.rule.minecartFeatureCommandPermis: Controls access to firework minecart and chain train configuration commands
carpet.rule.vehicleStopOnDismount.name: Vehicle Stop On Dismount
carpet.rule.vehicleStopOnDismount.desc: Controls whether a vehicle immediately loses horizontal speed when its controlling player dismounts
carpet.rule.wanderingTraderNoDespawn.des: false keeps vanilla behavior; true prevents every wandering trader from despawning; controlled protects only traders matching the /villagerPerformance wanderingTrader name or block lists.
Restores the bee collision box from before Minecraft 26.2: 0.7 blocks wide and 0.6 blocks high.
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.name: Client Dimension IDs
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.desc: Maps the client-visible dimension IDs for the Overworld, Nether, and End. This separates minimap and Voxy data without changing server-side dimensions.
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.extra.0: Use [overworld,the_nether,the_end] or exactly three custom IDs in the same order. Missing namespaces default to minecraft.
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.extra.1: Fake-player spawning, teleportation, server saves, and modded server dimensions are unchanged. Reconnect after changing this rule.
carpet.rule.removeDialogWarning.name: Remove Command Confirmation Warning
carpet.rule.removeDialogWarning.desc: Removes the confirmation warning for server-sent run-command clicks and dialog actions. Only available on Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer.
carpet.rule.removeDialogWarning.extra.0: Warning: Enable only for servers whose command content you trust.
carpet.rule.villagerBreedingAnimalizatio: Allows shift-right-click feeding to give adult villagers breeding willingness and speed up baby villager growth like other animals.
false: Keep vanilla villager breeding only.
true: Allow both vanilla food pickup and direct player feeding.
only: Only direct player feeding grants breeding willingness.
Baby villagers consume one item per feeding; bread provides the same growth boost as four consecutive carrot, potato, or beetroot feedings.
carpet.rule.hostileMobInventoryAccess.de: Opens a hostile mob's six equipment slots by shift-right-clicking it with both hands empty.
carpet.rule.droppedItemStackLimit.name: Dropped Item Stack Limit
carpet.rule.droppedItemStackLimit.desc: Enables separately configured server-side stack limits for ground items, player inventories, and containers through /droppedItemStackLimit, up to 1000000000 items. false disables the feature; true allows everyone to manage it; ops or 0-4 set the manager permission level.
carpet.rule.droppedItemMergeDistance.des: Changes the horizontal search distance for merging ground item entities; -1 keeps vanilla 0.5 blocks. The vertical search range is unchanged.
carpet.rule.unlimitedFillCommands.name: Unlimited Fill Commands
carpet.rule.unlimitedFillCommands.desc: Removes the volume limit from /fill and /fillbiome. Chunks must still be loaded and all other vanilla checks remain active.
carpet.rule.preStackMobDeathDrops.name: Pre-stack Mob Death Drops
carpet.rule.preStackMobDeathDrops.desc: Immediately pre-stacks compatible death drops from selected mob entity types. Use false or a list such as [zombified_piglin,zombie].
Entity IDs without a namespace use minecraft. Players, experience, block drops, and unselected mobs are unchanged.
Compatible drops from later selected-mob deaths in the same tick and configured range merge into the first entity.
carpet.rule.preStackMobDeathDropsRange.d: Sets the legacy three-dimensional same-tick merge range from 0 to 16 blocks; default is 1.5. Migrate to per-entity ranges with /dropPreStack.
carpet.rule.preStackDroppedItems.name: Drop Pre-stacking
carpet.rule.preStackDroppedItems.desc: Enables entity-death and block-drop pre-stacking configured by /dropPreStack. New command entries default to range 1.
carpet.rule.zombifiedPiglinDropReduction: Removes selected drops from zombified piglins.
goldEquipment: Remove gold armor, golden swords, and golden spears.
all: Remove both gold equipment and rotten flesh.
Gold nuggets and ingots are not affected.
carpet.rule.piglinBarterItemExclusions.d: Excludes selected items from piglin bartering results.
carpet.rule.piglinBarterItemExclusions.e: [potions]: Exclude regular, splash, and lingering potions.
[itemId,itemId]: Exclude custom item IDs; the minecraft namespace may be omitted.
carpet.rule.villagerPerformanceOptimizat: Enables villager performance optimization and controls access to /villagerPerformance: true for everyone, ops for OP level 2, or 1-4 for a minimum permission level.
Use /villagerPerformance help for clickable trade and Hero of the Village gift configuration.
carpet.rule.spectatorFreeTeleport.name: Spectator Free Teleport
carpet.rule.spectatorFreeTeleport.desc: Allows spectators to use /tp and /teleport on themselves only. Operators keep full vanilla teleport permissions unless TIS or AMS cheat prevention is enabled.
false: Keep vanilla teleport permission requirements.

true: Spectators may teleport themselves, including /tp @s and coordinate targets. Teleporting other entities is still denied. When TIS opPlayerNoCheat or AMS preventAdministratorCheat is enabled, OP spectators use the same self-only permission as non-OP spectators.
carpet.rule.PlayerTpEndControl.name: Player End Portal Teleport Control
carpet.rule.PlayerTpEndControl.desc: Controls player teleportation through End portals, End exit portals, and End gateways: false keeps vanilla behavior, true blocks all player portal teleports, and control uses per-player preferences managed by /playertpend
carpet.rule.PlayerTpEndControl.extra.0: In control mode, missing preferences allow every portal type by default. This server-side rule never blocks non-player entities.
carpet.rule.fullShulkerBoxCrafting.name: Full Shulker Box Crafting
carpet.rule.fullShulkerBoxCrafting.desc: Crafts full single-item shulker boxes through matching ordinary recipes, supports stacked full and empty boxes, returns spare boxes to the inventory, and drops overflow
carpet-fga-addition.fullShulkerBoxCrafti: Not enough empty shulker boxes; %s more required
Every input shulker box must be full of one identical item
Unstackable items cannot be used in full shulker box crafting
Input box capacities differ and cannot be fully consumed without leftovers
The recipe output is unstackable and cannot fill a shulker box
The recipe output does not form a whole number of full shulker boxes
The recipe has an unstackable remaining item
The remaining recipe items do not form whole full shulker boxes
This craft would produce too many shulker boxes
carpet.rule.fakePlayerItemSort.name: Fake Player Item Sorting
carpet.rule.fakePlayerItemSort.desc: Enables fake-player inventory sorting; use /fakePlayerItemSort to manage mode and sorter settings
carpet-fga-addition.command.fakePlayerIt: Rebuild every cached sorter inventory. Tasks run at a limited rate.
Queued %s sorter routes for rate-limited rebuild.
carpet.rule.voidWorldGeneration.name: Void World Generation
carpet.rule.voidWorldGeneration.desc: Makes newly generated chunks empty while retaining biome and structure-location data
carpet.rule.terrainRegenerationCommandPe: Controls access to terrain regeneration and void clearing commands
carpet.rule.endGatewayRegeneration.name: End Gateway Regeneration
carpet.rule.endGatewayRegeneration.desc: Regenerates destroyed vanilla End gateways using only the gateway block and its own data; surrounding blocks are unchanged.
Use /droppedItemStackLimit mode inventory or container to configure backpack and container limits separately.
carpet.rule.babyMobNoGrowth.name: Baby Mob No Growth
carpet.rule.babyMobNoGrowth.desc: Prevents all baby mobs or baby mobs with an exact case-sensitive custom name from growing, including tadpoles
carpet.rule.resilientPlants.name: Resilient Plants
carpet.rule.resilientPlants.desc: Lets matching plants ignore vanilla survival restrictions and be placed without normal support
carpet.rule.deepslateStonecuttingRecipes: Makes deepslate behave in the stonecutter like it does in 26.1+
carpet.rule.woodStonecuttingRecipes.name: Wood Stonecutting Recipes
carpet.rule.woodStonecuttingRecipes.desc: Allows wood products to be crafted in the stonecutter
carpet.rule.villagerDoNotCraftBread.name: Villagers Do Not Craft Bread
carpet.rule.villagerDoNotCraftBread.desc: Makes farmer villagers handle wheat like 26.3+ by no longer crafting it into bread
Lets villagers wait for and complete profession upgrades without closing the trading screen, like 26.3+
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.name: Player Load Distance
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.desc: Controls per-player chunk sending and tracking distance without changing simulation distance
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.extra.0: Use /playerLoadDistance help; temporary overrides expire on restart unless persistent is appended
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.extra.1: -1 keeps only the center chunk weakly loaded, 0 keeps the center strongly loaded and a 3x3 weak area, 1-32 sets a radius, and none removes player loading
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerPlayerMultiplier: Counts each matching trial participant as the configured number of players for trial mobs and rewards
Range 1-10000, default 100; 1 keeps the vanilla one-player scale
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerPlayerFilter.des: Selects players affected by the trial multiplier: false, true, bot_, or a custom name prefix
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerPlayerFilter.ext: false disables scaling; true matches everyone; other values use a case-sensitive name-prefix match
carpet.rule.trialStopCommandPermission.d: Enables and controls the /trialStop stop-and-refresh command with false, true, ops, or permission levels 0-4
carpet.fga.trialStop.clear: Remove only mobs tracked by this spawner
